comparability_limitations: Entire 2019 TREC trial-only corpus differs from four-source BCKB and its labels/roles.
Qrels already exposed from historical evaluation; this is a new full-corpus retrieval stress test, not a pristine held-out evaluation.
Role-labeled query is a deterministic lexical serialization, not a new learned role inference model.
No clinician gold on four-source safety is created by these official TREC judgments.
Corpus raw XML and official qrels stay outside public GitHub; only authored code, hash references, derived metrics are candidates for release.

experiment_design.FTS5_scoring: bm25 (SQLite internal defaults k1=1.2,b=0.75), ascending score; no learned weights
experiment_design.Q0_flat: Tokenize disease + gene + demographic values, lowercase ASCII-letter/digit regex, fixed English stopwords, deduplicate in order, OR tokens
experiment_design.Q1_role_labelled: Tokenize fixed field label condition, disease, fixed field label eligibility, gene, demographic (labels before values), same token and OR rules
experiment_design.R0_raw: Fields concatenated with spaces, no extra labels
experiment_design.R1_labelled: Fixed literal field labels title, condition, summary, description, eligibility precede the corresponding original text
experiment_design.missing_query_terms: No result if no token found; do not fallback to judged labels
experiment_design.pilot_rule: Run 5 topic IDs 1–5 for pipeline/operational checks without qrels; do not tune tokenizer/weights from judged effectiveness; after pipeline QA score all 40 and evaluate 38 judged
experiment_design.primary_metric: nDCG@10 linear qrel gain, per official historical convention, unjudged=0
experiment_design.rank_ties: Sort FTS5 ascending bm25 score, then deterministic NCT ID ascending
experiment_design.sampling_inference: descriptive paired per-topic only; no new independent p values from already-exposed qrels

outcome_policy: Report all positive, zero and negative outcomes. Preserve protocol and source SHAs. Any post-hoc variation must be explicitly labeled.
remote_push_policy: New nonforce research branch only after complete reproducibility, no main changes
resource: Mac CPU/SQLite only; no Kaggle GPUs or paid APIs
scope: New CPU SQLite FTS5 BM25 (porter unicode61) full-corpus lexical 2x2 evaluation of original TREC Precision Medicine 2019 trial snapshot; NOT a matched BCKB four-source replication
